title: Electro-catalytic carbon dioxide reduction to ethylene using single-atom copper catalysts

proposal.title: Investigation into Electro-catalytic carbon dioxide reduction to ethylene using single-atom copper catalysts: An Autonomous High-Assurance Research Framework
proposal.executive_summary: This investigation addresses urgent scientific and technical challenges in Electro-catalytic carbon dioxide reduction to ethylene using single-atom copper catalysts within the domain of Chemical Kinetics & Clean Energy Transition. Existing methodologies suffer from significant operational bottlenecks, empirical latency, and vulnerability to operational drift. Under the leadership of Dr. Anita Venkataraman at IIT Bombay, this 28-week grant project deploys a systematic four-phase investigative methodology designed to establish measurable performance breakthroughs, verifiable reproducibility, and statutory grant compliance.
proposal.methodology: The proposed methodology executes an end-to-end, empirical multi-stage research lifecycle: (Phase 1: Theoretical Modeling & Formulation) Formulate rigorous analytical representations and baseline telemetry protocols for Electro-catalytic carbon dioxide reduction to ethylene using single-atom copper catalysts. (Phase 2: Prototype & System Architecture) Design and implement modular prototype units integrating real-time sensory perception, algorithmic processing, and error-bounding guardrails. (Phase 3: Characterization & Stress Validation) Subject the integrated system to high-dimensional operational perturbations, cross-validating empirical findings against prior art. (Phase 4: Field Validation & Deployment) Conduct pilot validation in target experimental environments at IIT Bombay, accompanied by automated compliance auditing and artifact preservation.
